price_rule: last close of bar with stamp <= t; open = first-bar open (A-track D3)
close_rule: close of bar stamped 15:30 in vendor era / 15:29 in native and cas eras
excursion_rule: bars strictly after the cutoff bar, capped at the close stamp; mfe = max cumulative return, mae = min cumulative return
labeling_rule: first bar stamped 09:16 -> end-labelled (vendor price rule); 09:15 -> start-labelled (native price rule); anything else -> excluded

eligibility.note: first-bar check is label-based: 09:16 -> end-labelled, 09:15 -> start-labelled, other -> excluded

note_tolerance: matching tolerance for the same-return/different-path control: frozen at +/-10 bp on open->12:30 return (operator decision 2026-09-09)

state_c.definition: linear detrend of State A: C(t) = A(t) - (t/13)*A(12:30) over the 14 grid stamps; first and last elements are exactly 0; Euclidean distance, same as primaries
state_c.role: diagnostic only - shape similarity with endpoint magnitude removed

control.note: same-return/different-path control: matched set = pool days with |R_j - R_D| <= 10bp; near/far split at the median State-C distance within the matched set; groups smaller than min_matched_group are skipped and counted
